meta_title: PLC Gardening Services | Professional Gardener Sheffield
meta_description: PLC Gardening Services Sheffield. Professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and design. Local gardeners you can trust. Call 07897 668071 for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Garden Care — Fully Insured & Local
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden transformations. We handle it all, so your garden looks its best year-round.
services_subhead: Whether you need a spring tidy-up, a new patio, or a complete garden redesign, we've got the skills and experience to bring your vision to life.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Tidy-ups
services.desc: Regular hedge trimming, lawn mowing, border weeding, and seasonal clean-ups. We keep your garden looking cared-for all year, with flexible visit schedules to suit your needs.

services.title: Landscaping & Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Patios, decking, pathways, and boundary work. We design and build gardens that blend beauty with durability, using quality materials built to last.

services.title: Planting & Garden Design
services.desc: Expert plant selection for your soil and sunlight. We create planting schemes that add colour, structure, and wildlife appeal to your space.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Pruning
services.desc: Safe, skilled pruning to keep trees healthy and shapely. We handle everything from fruit trees to ornamental specimens, improving both health and appearance.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Removal
services.desc: Overgrown garden? We clear, remove, and dispose responsibly. We'll leave your space ready for a fresh start or new planting scheme.

services.title: Seasonal Garden Care
services.desc: Spring preparation, summer maintenance, autumn clear-ups, and winter protection. We keep your garden ahead of the seasons.

about_pullquote: A neglected garden winds you up. Ours don't get neglected.
about_para_1: PLC Gardening Services was founded on a simple idea: Sheffield residents deserve reliable, honest garden care without the fuss. Over 15 years, we've grown from a one-man operation to a trusted local team, handling everything from small maintenance visits to complete garden redesigns. We're fully insured, take pride in our work, and treat every garden as if it were our own.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, doing the job right, and leaving you with a garden you actually enjoy. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and local referrals — the best compliment a gardener can get. We listen to what you want, offer honest advice, and get the job done without the sales pitch.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Our garden was a jungle when we moved in. PLC came round, gave us a realistic plan, and got stuck in. Took about three weeks but it's transformed. Really professional bunch, fair pricing, and they cleared everything away. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had Mark and the team do our patio and new borders. Excellent work, turned up when they said they would, and the attention to detail was brilliant. They even sorted out drainage that we didn't know we needed. Best money we've spent on the garden.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: We've had PLC do our maintenance for three years now. They're reliable, friendly, and our garden looks cared for all year. No hassle, fair price, and they know what they're doing. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Robert K.
